capture: s3-book / flights — fare selection, reached via Kayak handoff
PARTIAL_CAPTURE_WARNING: This is NOT Iberia's competitor pass. It is the destination of a Kayak handoff, entered mid-journey at fare selection. No Iberia site tree, no s1, no loyalty, no airport services. The full tier-4 pass is still owed and must not be mistaken for a re-pass.

arrival_state.entry_point: deep link from kayak.es carrying the full itinerary and fare code
arrival_state.fare_preselected_verbatim_es: Has escogido la tarifa: Turista Básica
arrival_state.translation: You have chosen the fare: Basic Economy
arrival_state.note: The traveller did not choose this. Kayak's result carried FareCode1=AANNANB4 and Iberia states it back as the traveller's own choice.

finding_F51_CHEAPEST_ROUTES_TO_LEAST_FLE.claim: The meta-search handoff deposits the traveller, pre-selected, into the airline's most restrictive fare family.
finding_F51_CHEAPEST_ROUTES_TO_LEAST_FLE.chain_observed: Kayak sort 'El más barato' / lowest displayed result -> handoff URL carries the basic fare code -> Iberia opens with 'Turista Básica' already chosen.
finding_F51_CHEAPEST_ROUTES_TO_LEAST_FLE.why_it_matters: F-49 established that protection varies across a Kayak result set and is never displayed. This shows the mechanism completing: the cheapest path is not merely less protected in the abstract, it ARRIVES pre-committed to the least flexible fare, described to the traveller as their own decision. A first-time traveller who clicked 'cheapest' has now, without a further choice, selected the fare with the least change and cancellation freedom.
finding_F51_CHEAPEST_ROUTES_TO_LEAST_FLE.our_product_decision_required: Decision required: if Luma hands off, does it hand off to a CHOICE or to a pre-selected commitment? Kayak's convenience here is also the removal of a decision the traveller did not know they were making.

finding_F52_THE_AIRLINE_IS_MORE_TRANSPAR.claim: Iberia states an all-in total with a named exception. Kayak, which sent the traveller here, states that its prices exclude baggage fees.

evidence.Iberia_verbatim_es: Precio total, incluye tarifa aérea, tasas (salvo las que se cobren en determinados aeropuertos en el momento de facturar), gastos de gestión, cargos...
evidence.translation: Total price, includes airfare, taxes (except those charged at certain airports at check-in), handling fees, charges...
evidence.Kayak_verbatim_es: Los precios son por persona y no incluyen tasas de equipaje (F-46)

finding_F52_THE_AIRLINE_IS_MORE_TRANSPAR.why_it_matters: The supplier is more honest about price construction than the comparison layer above it — and names the specific exception rather than gesturing at one. This inverts the assumption that intermediaries protect travellers from supplier opacity. On price, the opposite held here.
finding_F52_THE_AIRLINE_IS_MORE_TRANSPAR.significance_for_tier_4: This is the first evidence bearing on the reason tier 4 was added: with no supplier in the sample, claims about 'the market' were claims about intermediaries. One supplier surface already contradicts one.

price_consistency_check.kayak_displayed: 58,25 € (passed as DisplayedPrice=58.25 in the handoff URL)
price_consistency_check.observation: The 58,25 € figure Kayak passed appears on the Iberia page. The 28 € and 31 € are the individual leg fares.
price_consistency_check.assessment: Price survived the handoff intact on this result. Recorded as observed, one result only.

Turista Básica includes: Equipaje de hasta 10 kg (cabin bag up to 10 kg)
fare_content_observed.note: A 10 kg cabin allowance IS included in the basic fare — which means Kayak's blanket 'prices do not include baggage fees' understates what this particular fare carries. The warning is generic; the fare is specific.

not_observed_and_OWED_for_the_full_iberi: Iberia site tree and s1 discovery
Iberia Plus / Avios loyalty structure — no loyalty signal on this page
airport services: lounges, Fast Track — the business-goal-5 comparator, the main reason Qatar and Iberia are on the roster
seat selection, change and cancellation terms per fare family
disruption handling and EU 261 posture — THE tier-4 test, untouched
